justification: Both are engravings on a natural rock face using schematic, reduced forms, but A shows a single large, dense, deeply relief-carved composition of interlocking curvilinear/zoomorphic-looking forms filling one panel, whereas B shows a scattered assemblage of discrete stick-like human figures with raised arms, a spiral, a boat with crew-strokes, cup marks and long straight lines. The specific iconography — armed anthropomorphs, spiral and boat in B versus the massed curved coils and cupped hollows of A — shares no distinctive motif or relationship.
